title: Unraveling the molecular heterogeneity in type 2 diabetes: a potential subtype discovery followed by metabolic modeling
summary: Primary BMC Medical Genomics Results identify three T2DM expression clusters and distinct metabolic flux/gene patterns from 154 skeletal-muscle profiles; the earlier Research Square V1 reports the same three clusters and pathway result. These are computationally inferred subtypes, not clinically validated categories.
ai_technology: GA-SVM selects expression features; hierarchical clustering groups T2DM profiles and flux models characterize pathways.
organization: Laboratory of Complex Biological Systems and Bioinformatics (CBB), Department of Bioinformatics, Institute of Biochemistry and Biophysics (IBB), University of Tehran, Tehran, Iran

evidence.tested: From 63 newly diagnosed T2DM and 91 controls, 26 genes classify groups at 94% repeated CV; three patient clusters show distinct expression/flux patterns.
evidence.unknown: Repeated internal CV for classification; metabolic mechanism inference is computational and no independent clinical cohort or experimental perturbation validates subtype biology.
evidence.ai_role: GA-SVM selects expression features; hierarchical clustering groups T2DM profiles and flux models characterize pathways.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
